messages:
maya: Heads-up: mariner-v2 weights uploaded to s3 but manifest resolver failing. looks like trailing slash in URI. also tokenizer shows new unk token id shift (+1).

liam: @maya can you paste the exact URI? I'll run resolver locally :eyes:

maya: ```
weights_uri: s3://redwood-models/mariner/v2/weights/
manifest: s3://redwood-models/mariner/v2/manifest.json
```

liam: ah yeah the catalog lint expects no trailing slash. Quick fix is to normalize in catalog ingestion. I'll open PR, but we should confirm no other artifacts depend on trailing slash.

asha: Tokenizer shift is concerning — was the tokenizer regenerated? mariner-v2 should be compatible with previous vocab. @tom any idea?

tom: Tokenizer revamp slipped in last model pass. New vocab token <|sep2|> added which changed ids. We have two options: ship a compatibility map or pin mariner-v2-compat that uses old tokenizer. For canary I'd prefer compatibility map + validation prompt set.

maya: ok let's do compatibility map for now. I'll add mapping file to s3: s3://redwood-models/mariner/v2/tokenizer/compat_map.json

liam: Also creating catalog entry patch to strip trailing slash and add 'compatibility_map' field. Will target eng-runtime->staging canary in us-west-2 for 1% traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: catalog:mariner:v2 -> us-west-2, traffic:1%, job: roll/1937654321, started

tom: Reminder: add model config flag 'pin_version: v2.0.1' in dedicated entries so Dedicated doesn't auto-upgrade. Also add fallback to mariner-v1 in config.

asha: Config lint results: failing on 'max_sequence' mismatch (v1:2048 v2:4096). Need runtime check to prevent 4096 in low-memory pools. I'll add validator.

liam: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/412 — strips slash, adds compat map + canary metadata. @maya can you sanity test the tokenizer mapping against eval prompt set?

maya: Running quick eval now. Polling logs... so far generation quality stable on small prompts. Will post results within 30m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Alert: us-west-2 GPU pool capacity low, canary may fallback to us-east-1 if constrained. Auto-fallback enabled.

tom: Good catch. Let's pin canary to us-west-2 but allow fallback region policy 'soft' for 10m grace window.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with eval artifacts and add compat_map link in PR.
